# The property grid's field catalogue (WP-S2.05 §6.1), generated by tests/property_grid.rs: one line per node,
# `<kind> <path> <type> <category> <route>[ identifier]`; a group header (a group or list without a route of its
# own whose members are editable) shows `-` for its route (FT-427).
